# Trovelo

> Trovelo is a private travel planner for iPhone, iPad and Mac. It keeps a whole trip in one place, organised day by day: flights, hotels, trains, tickets, places to see, notes and expenses. It's free to use for up to 2 upcoming trips with 50 cards each, and Trovelo Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

Trovelo is made by Eduardo Pinillos, an independent developer based in Portugal (Pinillos Lab), with no investors. It's available in 13 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch, Danish, Swedish, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).

Key facts:

- Platforms: iPhone, iPad and Mac, native on each. While you travel, what's now and what's next also show on Apple Watch (watchOS 11 or later), with nothing to install on the watch.
- Price: free for up to 2 upcoming trips at a time, with 50 cards in each. Past trips don't count. Trovelo Pro is a single payment through the App Store that unlocks unlimited trips and cards, the Pro guides, connecting an AI assistant on the Mac, and every future Pro feature.
- Privacy: there's no account to create and no ads. Trovelo has no servers of its own: trips live on your devices and sync through your own iCloud.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760258252 (one listing for iPhone, iPad and Mac). Trovelo Pro goes with your Apple Account, on all three.

What it does:

- Board: one column per day, with cards for flights (including layovers), hotels, trains, buses, ferries, rental cars, tickets, food, sights and notes. A daily pace shows when a day is already too full.
- Map: every day on a map, with routes between stops, a button to put a day in the best order, places nearby, and pins you drop yourself.
- Plan with AI on the Mac (Pro): connect Trovelo to Claude, or another AI assistant that supports MCP, ask for a trip in plain words, and it appears on your board and then on your iPhone. The connection is off until you turn it on.
- Plan together: invite the people travelling with you by name, as "Can view" or "Can edit". Your home address, packing list, documents and your own spending are never shared.
- Expenses: in two currencies with live exchange rates, plus splitting costs with your group.
- Booking emails: import flights, hotels and rental cars from booking confirmation emails.
- Someday: save places you want to visit before any trip exists, and add them to a trip later.
- Guides: 56 ready-made trips to start from.
- My Spots: a map of every country and city you've been to, built from your own photos, with medals and a year-by-year timeline.
- Packing list that checks the forecast and the plug type where you're going, typical weather and a live forecast, Lock Screen Live Activities, widgets, Calendar, and a full backup of all your trips.
